title: Tatsuki Fujimoto Before Chainsaw Man: 17-21
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The first of two volumes collecting Tatsuki Fujimoto's early one-shots (written 2011 to 2014). Two human survivors disguise themselves as chickens in a school taken over by aliens who treat humans as livestock; a boy tries to protect his idolized teacher; a student council president resolves to confess his love before graduation; and an assassin is hired by a weary immortal vampire to end his life, and the two form a bond.
life_message: Stubborn love and empathy, even in absurd or brutal worlds, are what keep people going.

folkways.japan: School settings, student council duties and a pupil's devotion to his teacher (sensei) reflect Japanese school culture, which Fujimoto twists toward the absurd.
